answer.held_back_by: I think it was the Cabinet question in Y43. Being right about pay in public cost me standing with the people who decide who goes further. No scholarship and a local degree probably capped me too, but the game never says so outright.
answer.ending_fair_why: It matched the run. I reached Minister at 72 with integrity at 100 and middling standing, and 'served, the service continued' is how an insider would put it. I would have liked a line that acknowledged the Y43 cost.
answer.chase_next: The role above Minister. I never saw it and want to know if it is reachable. I would also try a scholarship-style start, or staying quiet in Y43, to see whether the standing penalty was what blocked it.
answer.play_again_why: The Y43 branch left me curious what a quieter me would have got. But the middle years were repetitive, so I would play once more, not many times.

tone_breaks.line: Pay header and annual package disagree
tone_breaks.note: The salary header and the package differing felt like a bug, not a feature. Real benchmarked pay would be consistent within a year, so it distracted me.
Real appraisal wording is formulaic and tied to the ranking, so erratic wording broke the insider feel. This one is a minor gripe.

answer.title_fit_why: The pay and benchmarking questions were the sharpest parts of the game and the Y43 bonus choice defined my run. 'Confirmed & Substantive' fits the appraisal and grade mechanics, but they mattered less to me.
